samples.text: Nvidia shares jumped 8% after the chipmaker raised its data-center revenue guidance.
Fed holds rates steady; Powell signals two cuts later this year as inflation cools.
Apple and Microsoft led the Nasdaq higher while Tesla slipped on weaker China deliveries.
JPMorgan Chase beat estimates as net interest income rose; Wells Fargo lagged.
Oil prices surged after OPEC+ announced deeper production cuts, lifting Exxon Mobil and Chevron.
US CPI rose 3.2% year over year, hotter than expected, pushing Treasury yields higher.
Boeing (BA) said 737 MAX deliveries will slow; FedEx warned on freight demand.
